Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the target CHEMBL1741186. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering by target chembl_id CHEMBL1741186 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical SMILES. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
